Cohort statements (means, ranges, "one patient" bleeding sentence, two continuing on faricimab and two switched back) are not copied to individuals; only sentences explicitly covering all four patients or labelled cases are used.
Text and table values that share numbers but differ in labelled time point (presentation versus Pre switch, time of switching versus first faricimab dose) are kept as separate observations.
Table 2 prints NA (Not Applicable) in the Previous treatment columns for cases 1 and 3; recorded as not applicable, not as zero.
Visual acuity is reported as logMAR BCVA in table headers; narrative sentences without logMAR carry no unit.
No supplementary material is listed in the source.

Table 1 Subsequent treatment cells appear glued in the parsed text ("4 faricimab2 aflibercept"); the raw JATS XML separates the counts with line breaks, so the split into drug-count entries is unambiguous. The order of the listed counts is not stated as a sequence and is not used for timing.

Case 3: Table 1 Subsequent treatment lists 1 faricimab, 7 aflibercept and 5 faricimab, while the text gives one faricimab injection and then seven aflibercept and four faricimab injections over 13 months; the later faricimab count (5 versus 4) is a source conflict and both count facts are review_only.

The results sentences "all eyes experienced a reduction in SRF and improved visual acuity at 4-6 weeks" and "worsening of inferior macular PEDs was noticed in all patients after 1-4 faricimab injections and 4-9 weeks" give cohort ranges; the per-case sections state each patient's own findings, so these ranges are not copied to individuals. The b00017 sentence that all patients were followed after their unexpected responses is used only to order the follow-up after each unexpected response.

Table 1/2 column headers (Previous treatment, Pre switch, first faricimab dose, At unexpected response, Final visit) are modelled as events; text values with a differently worded time label (presentation, at the time of switching, end of follow-up, latest follow-up, visual acuity versus logMAR BCVA) stay separate observations with ambiguities.
